scenario: Every async call carries an `as` binding per LCRS.3.1 — either explicit via `as <expr>` or synthesized per LCCO.3.4. Pin: a `call` with a continuation and NO explicit `as` compiles cleanly; the compiler synthesizes a `$<rule>_c0_g<k>` correlation.
rules_ds:
schema SensorReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    code: Int

service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SensorReadReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min
        on response.code == 200:
            log info "ok"
